candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when the fallback accepts and updates state.
Remove the time ordering check by replacing require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) with require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime), allowing equal timestamps to update state.
Change assignment to pastBlockTime to set it to block.number rather than block.timestamp, altering the stored value observed later.
Remove the conditional transfer so the contract never pays out on multiples of 15, changing balance and subsequent observable behavior.
Invert the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0, altering when payouts occur and thus observable balance/state.
